summary.en: One provider card, fifteen free-tier vendors (LLM7, NaraRoute, xKiro, SambaNova, Cohere, Hugging Face, Cloudflare Workers AI, Mistral, Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter, Kilo, OpenCode Zen, Ollama Cloud, NVIDIA NIM). Paste every key you have once; models route by prefix, and every entry points at its own upstream.
summary.zh: 一张卡装 15 家有免费额度的渠道（LLM7、NaraRoute、xKiro、SambaNova、Cohere、Hugging Face、Cloudflare Workers AI、Mistral、Groq、Gemini、OpenRouter、Kilo、OpenCode Zen、Ollama Cloud、NVIDIA NIM）。所有 key 一次粘贴配齐（LLM7 免 key），模型按前缀分流到各自上游。
